style: Avant-garde art-punk and trashy cabaret post-punk, harmony=Sléndro-informed five-step pitch field with bitonal modal drone and microtonal friction, melody=Angular cabaret patter with lexical tone contours and glottalized vowel leaps, rhythm=3:2 coupling pulse with asymmetric motorik subdivision and chaotic body percussion, timbre=Fluorescent ballast hum, shift-register noise, tape loops, 8-bit pulse, cristal baschet, spring reverb, and thunder sheet, vocal=Leader plus distorted echo group with obsessive glottal stops and L1 Akan transfer, performance=Trashy cheap spectacle delivered straight under extreme panic-under-function pressure, production=Dry close-miked studio recording with local spring reverb washes and tape saturation, dynamic contour=Abrupt amplitude jumps with sudden spatial pan shifts and raw transient clamping across every single channel in the mix

[Leader] No but really, uh-'ah!

[Echo Group] (Receipt paper! Uh-'ah!)

[Echo Group] (No consent! No consent! A'a!)

[Chorus]
[Full Ensemble] No but really! Ugh! Why am I like this?!

[Echo Group] (Out of the wall! Uh-'ah!)

[Echo Group] (No postage! A'a!)

[Verse 2]
[Leader] The parasite intern unlocked the administrative basement!
It is breeding little logic errors in the water cooler!
[Echo Group] (Water cooler! A'a!)

[Magnetic Tape Loop Wow And Flutter] [Body Percussion Footfalls Accelerating]

[Echo Group] (Unindexed folder! Uh-'ah!)
[Leader] The backup generator hums with the frequency of my regret!
[Leader] I tried to update my psychological profile but the screen shattered!
[Echo Group] (Screen shattered! A'a!)

[Bridge — Jurisdiction Dropout: Bass And Drums Cut Out Suddenly]
[Leader — Spoken Dry, Close-Miked, Extreme Panic-Under-Function]
No but really. If I stop moving, the classification becomes permanent.
If the category is permanent, I am legally a filing cabinet.
[Echo Group Whispering] (File cabinet. Uh-'ah. File cabinet.)
[Leader] Ugh! Why am I like this?!
[Leader] My spine is organizing itself into alphabetical tabs!
[Leader] Every vertebra is a manila folder filled with obsolete forms!
[Leader] The bureaucratic machinery of my mind has locked all the emergency exits!
[Echo Group Whispering] (No exits. Locked doors. A'a.)

[Build — Perpetual Uplift Triggered By Density Threshold]
[Shift-Register Noise Clock Accelerates] [8-Bit Pulse-Wave Arpeggios Multiplying]

[Echo Group Shouting] (Metal sheet! Metal sheet! A'a! Uh-'ah!)
[Leader] The architecture of my personality is collapsing into a spreadsheet!
[Echo Group] (Spreadsheet! Spreadsheet! A'a!)

[Chorus — Full Ensemble, Maximum Kinetic Velocity]
[Leader + Echo Group] No but really! Ugh! Why am I like this?!
[Crystall Baschet Bowed glass Arcs] [Spring Reverb Tank Feedback Fog]
[Leader] The wrong category is the only home we have left!
[Echo Group] (The only home! The only home! Uh-'ah!)
[Leader] We live inside the error log and pay rent with static electricity!
[Leader] The filing cabinets are breeding in the corridors of my subconscious!

[Outro — Sudden Dry Cut, Only Fluorescent Ballast Hum And Tape Hiss Remain]
[Leader — Spoken, Exhausted, Glottalized]
No but really.
Ugh.
[Tape Loop Splice Click] [Silence]
caption: An avant-garde art-punk track driven by sléndro pentatonic tuning, 3:2 rhythmic coupling, and Akan-influenced phonological transfer. The song explores taxonomic panic and cognitive system failure through trashy theatrical energy, fluorescent ballast hums, cristal baschet resonating glass, and a leader-plus-echo vocal topology under extreme panic-under-function pressure. Every behavioral glitch is amplified by structural instability and digital decay across all channels.
